rules: Career Goals supplies personal criteria and exceptions; the master supplies candidate facts. Public Review defines only extraction, ratings and score routing.
Run owns objective duplicate discovery; IDs or verified posting-specific links confirm identity, names/dates corroborate. Preserve actual application history.
Review scores and routing live only in stages/review.md. Use its ordered decisions, preserve unknown evidence, and pin its automatic content fingerprint.
Freeze source/policy/JD/PDF identities; revalidate affected decisions when they change. Historical approvals do not manufacture current scored acceptance.
Run identity, truthful PDF, actual submission authorization and uncertain-attempt safeguards remain independent of fit scores.

Curate owns company targeting proposals, employer-policy research and computed holds. Holds never change role fit; Apply recomputes the hold with scripts/company_policy.py:apply_allowed before Submit.

Prepare reuses an approved base only with complete coverage and a current master; otherwise it tailors from the closest base under the registered resume guidelines. Base creation is offline. resume_ready checks the recorded path evidence.

Apply submits only when Pause applications is off and Settings.submission_policy.max_per_day allows (scripts/submission_policy.py:submission_gate), plus apply_ready, the company hold check and the fixed safety rules. Answers come only from the answer bank.
review_identity: SHA-256 of the exact Review file, computed automatically by scripts/role_gate.py
